stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 rebase [--continue|--abort] [--onto=<newbase>] [<upstream>]
                    [<branch>]

Reapply commits on top of another base tip.

Examples:
  git2 rebase <upstream>
  git2 rebase --onto <newbase> <upstream> [<branch>]
  git2 rebase --continue
  git2 rebase --abort

Options:
    --continue
        continue an in-progress rebase
    --abort
        abort an in-progress rebase
    --onto=<newbase>
        rebase onto the given branch or commit
    <upstream>
        upstream branch or commit to rebase onto
    <branch>
        branch to rebase (defaults to current branch)
